name: tunnel lining
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 隧道内用于支护、承载和防护的衬砌结构。
usage_overview: 在列车—轨道—隧道相互作用分析中，隧道衬砌作为围岩与轨道之间传递作用的结构纳入动力模型，用于分析隧道错动条件下的系统响应。

complete_examples.text: Niu [3] pointed out that the early construction quality, design, and acceptance standards of tunnels were relatively low, resulting in initial defects in the tunnel lining structure.
The basement defects have a significant effect on the train running status, track vibration displacement, and vibration stress of the tunnel lining structure.

The parameters used in the model establishment are listed as follows: (1) The inner diameter of each arc in the tunnel section: R1, R2, R3, R4 (2) The center coordinates of each arc of the tunnel section: zr1, zr2, zr3, zr4, yr1, yr2, yr3, yr4 (3) The total thickness of tunnel lining: D (4) The thickness of each layer of tunnel lining grid: d (5) Longitudinal length of tunnel lining grid: lt (6) Elastic modulus and Poisson’s ratio of tunnel lining: Et and ut (7) Mass density of tunnel lining: ρt (8) Connection stiffness and damping between tunnel segment and surrounding rock mass: kts, cts (9) The angle between the global Y-axis of the tunnel and the tunnel lining grid node: α (10) The number of grid layers of the tunnel grid node: j According to the principle of isoparametric element, the shape functions used in the 8-node isoparametric element can be described as Ni 1⁄4 ð1 þ ξiξÞð1 þ ηiηÞð1 þ ζ iζÞ , i 1⁄4 1, 2, .
